description: Use when the user asks whether a company or person is sanctioned, blocked, debarred or excluded, or wants a KYC/vendor/export check. Checks a company (kind entity) or person (kind person) against these lists: US Consolidated Screening List (trade.gov); OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (HHS); SAM.gov Exclusions (GSA); Pennsylvania Medicheck Precluded Providers (PA DHS). Not covered: state Medicaid exclusion lists other than Pennsylvania, non-US lists (UN, EU, UK). A clear result here does not clear those. Returns strong/possible matches with the official source of each, and which lists were checked when. Needs a key for the screening API (get_api_key with its api_id from search_apis "compliance"); $0.10 per check after free checks, or included in a monthly plan.

api_key.description: Optional; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 checks free within 48 hours).
